summary: Document the post-corpus-update ritual: golden queries -> re-distill -> re-derive
description: One doc (docs/ or the derive node file) chaining the three rituals with their gates: (1) per-work golden queries ship with the corpus change (guru-web docs/golden-queries.md); (2) student re-distill via the rellm scorer pipeline (~1 GPU-hour scripted; gates: teacher r >= 0.85, gold-eval AUC, ship-gate protocol — rellm docs/edges/thin-scorer-spec.md); (3) re-derive parallels and spot-check panels. State plainly which steps are owner-gated.
